agenda_text:
Councilman Alex Padilla

  District 2 Town Hall Meeting
  Thursday, May 8, 2014
  6:30 PM - 9:00 PM
  City Hall Community Room A

  ~Agenda~
  Councilman Padilla, Welcome and Introduction
  IPD Chief Fronterrota, Public Safety
  IUSD Superintendent Dr. Brann, State of the IUSD
 Public Works Director, Louis Atwell, Tree trimming, sidewalk and street
  repairs, street lighting
Hollywood Park Tomorrow, Gerard McCallum, Update on Hollywood Park
  Tomorrow Project

 Note: Parking is FREE in the City parking structure. Doors will open at 6:00 PM.
  Arrive early and join our Relay for Life Team.

  To RSVP please contact us at: 310.412.8601 or email us at
  cd2@cityofinglewood.org.
